subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir textos sobre temas de interesse, com base em resultados de observações e pesquisas em fontes de informações impressas ou eletrônicas, incluindo, quando pertinente, imagens e gráficos ou tabelas simples, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Planejar texto sobre tema de interesse a partir de fontes de pesquisa impressas ou eletrônicas
components.description_en: Plan a text on a topic of interest drawing on print or electronic research sources
components.cc_component_description: Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources on a research topic

components.description_pt: Integrar descrições textuais com formatos visuais como diagramas, gráficos ou tabelas
components.description_en: Integrate textual descriptions with visual formats such as diagrams, graphs, or tables
components.cc_component_description: Integrate textual descriptions with visual formats such as diagrams, graphs, or tables

components.description_pt: Produzir texto baseado em pesquisa considerando situação comunicativa e tema
components.description_en: Produce a research-based text considering the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

cc_matches.description: Integrate quantitative or technical information expressed in words in a text with a version of that information expressed visually (e.g., in a flowchart, diagram, model, graph, or table).

Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources; assess the credibility of each source; and quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and providing basic bibliographic information for sources.

With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
